title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Big Tech crushed, value rotated. The tape was a violent style rotation: semis collapsed (-4.8% SOXX) while defensives and cyclicals surged, all against a sharp oil reversal. This is a clear high-to-low rotation out of AI hardware into broad risk-on value, driven by oil volatility and pre-FOMC positioning.

INDICES — VIX 18.2 above 20d MA. Rank: DIA +1.08%, SPY +0.24%, IWM +0.16%, QQQ -0.97%, ^SOX -4.80%. Small > large by 0.31pp. TLT +0.59% bonds gained on flight-to-safety.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 1.0x (neutral), QQQ 0.9x (below avg). RSP 1.9x volume with price +1.17% = accumulation; SOXX 1.6x with -4.80% = distribution. XLP 2.3x gaining = defensive accumulation; XLU/XLC declining volume = ignored.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.36%, XLP Staples +1.99%, XLC Comms +1.87%, XLB Materials +1.85%, XLY Discretionary +1.48%, XLF Financials +1.27%, XLRE Real Estate +0.55%, XLU Utilities -0.35%, XLI Industrials -0.39%, XLE Energy -1.35%, XLK Technology -1.84%. Top industries: JETS +2.87%, IHI +2.57%; bottom: SOXX -4.80%, DRAM -8.89%. Strong money flowing out of Tech/Energy into Healthcare and Staples; weak money in XLK and XLE. Rotation state: broad risk-on with defensive bias.

POSITIONING — SPY put-call vol ratio 1.04 elevated, QQQ 1.63 very high = heavy protection. IV skew positive (fear). SPY gamma flip at 758; spot near 510s = no immediate flip. VIX 18.2 > 20d MA 17.0 = elevated fear.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil plunged 3.42% USO while bonds rallied 0.59% TLT — the oil reversal triggered a large unwind of energy-sector longs into safe havens. Gold fell 1.40% despite risk-off, unusual divergence explained by dollar strength and oil correlation breakdown.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 63 Greed. Top movers: DRAM -8.89% (Semis), KO +5.00% (Staples), UPS -6.57% (Freight). 20d momentum extremes: worst sector XLK -7.72% best XLF +7.52%; worst basket DRAM. Vol spike: TAN 5.2x -4.77% = distribution; XLP 2.3x +1.99% = accumulation. Catalyst: oil crash and pre-FOMC jitters crushed semis. Tomorrow watch: UPS (vol spike + distribution, freight weakness signal), MU (DRAM basket leader, near 20d lows), XLP (accumulation spike, watch if staples can hold vs rotation breadth).
